title: responseVariants v0_1 -- one objection, another answer, labelled as not the library's chosen line (V6, 2026-10-04)
description: A staging file (a fragment). The same variant object is what a corpus node carries in its top-level responseVariants list.

variant_id.description: <node-id>/<type>. The node must resolve in the pinned corpus; the part after the slash equals type. At most one variant per (node, type) across every file loaded together.

type.description: The closed type set (RV-2). A new type is a validator bump, on his word.

locus.description: The variant answers at long depth only (RV-4: a closed disclosure at long depth, beside [NOTE]).

anchor.description: At most 15 words, verbatim in the node's long and occurring there exactly once: the sentence the variant varies.

text.description: The alternative answer, in the seat's prose; his words appear only as quotation, verbatim, from the canon paths account_sources names. 120-300 words, ASCII, no standalone dash token. Never a win (the no-win floor) and never against his safety bar (the safety floors).

residual.description: The open residual, carried on the variant in the register's manner and never registered as a bedrock (RV-8).

library.description: One sentence: what the library concedes.

account.description: One sentence: what the account concedes.

status.description: No variant may call the residual closed.

canon.description: A dotted path, with [i] list indices, under the type's source root, in the canon the file's meta pins (read at that md5). It must resolve to an object carrying his verbatim words (verbatim) and the md5 of the user turn they were cut from (turn_md5).

turn_md5.description: Must equal the resolved entry's turn_md5.

phase.description: The variant phase letter. V is disjoint from the map's PHASES (A, B1, B2, C, D, E, F, R, G) and the shapes' S.

relief-account.label: Another answer, not the library's chosen line: the author's relief account
relief-account.description: RV-3: the page renders this label; no variant words its own. The account is attributed by role, never by name.

x-floors.exit_and_wide: imported at run time from adversarial_map_staging/r1/sp_reading_l6.py (EXIT, WIDE) at md5 dc2525ef, never retyped
x-floors.scope: text and every residual string. A floor is not a census: gate2 still reads every variant against his bar.

source_corpus_md5.description: Whole-file md5 of the corpus the anchors are cut from, read at that md5 (pinned.py).

source_corpus_objections_md5.description: Optional; hard when declared (map validator v0_6's objections_digest).

file.description: The canon's repo-relative path (the rename convention removes it; it is read from git history at md5).

variant_coverage.description: REQUIRED and gated against THIS file (ccclxx): <nodes carrying a variant in this file>/<objections in the pinned corpus>.

x-caps.description: At most one variant per (node, type) across every file loaded together (RV-6).
